{{Article status|status=Needs review|mode=Both|version=Elite Dangerous, current Live and Legacy|reviewed=2026-08-20|reviewer=EDFM Engineer link-graph pass|source_quality=Well-established core mechanic, unchanged since launch; no citation-dependent figures asserted}}

The '''Shield Generator''' is a core internal module that projects a ship's deflector shield, absorbing damage before it reaches the hull. Not every ship carries one — it occupies a core internal slot that a Commander can instead leave empty or fill with a different core internal module, trading defence for other priorities.

== Overview ==

A Shield Generator needs sufficient spare capacity from the [[Power Plant]] and [[Power Distributor]] to stay raised; if the ship draws too much power elsewhere, the shield can collapse ("shields down") until enough capacity is freed up. Shield strength is also boosted by any fitted [[Shield Booster]] utility modules.
